```{r}
nqc_plants <- nqc |>
    group_by(`Generator Name`,  year) |>
    slice_max(order_by = capacity, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    select(!month) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(gen_name_abb1 = str_to_lower(str_extract(`Generator Name`, "^[^ ]+")),
           gen_name_abb2 = str_to_lower(str_extract(`Generator Name`, "(?<=\\s)\\w+")))

nameplate_plants <- nameplate_clean |>
    mutate(gen_name_abb1 = str_to_lower(str_extract(`Plant Name`, "^[^ ]+")),
           gen_name_abb2 = str_to_lower(str_extract(`Plant Name`, "(?<=\\s)\\w+")))

get_possible_nameplate_plants <- function(nameplate_plant, nameplate_capacity, nabb1, nabb2) {

    first_filter <- nqc_plants |>
        filter(year == year,
               nameplate_capacity >= capacity,
               nabb1 == gen_name_abb1)

    if (NROW(first_filter) == 0) {
        nqc_plants |>
            filter(year == year,
                nameplate_capacity >= capacity,
                nabb1 == gen_name_abb1 | nabb2 == gen_name_abb2)
    }


}

nqc_plants |>
        filter(year == 2023,
               2202 >= capacity,
               "diablo" == gen_name_abb1)

map_dfr(.x = nqc_plants,
        .y = year,
        .f = get_possible_nameplate_plants)
nqc_plants |>
        filter(year == 2023,
               capacity >= 100)
```



```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringdist)

clean_generator_name <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(x)

  paren <- str_extract_all(x, "\\([^)]*\\)")
  paren_clean <- map(paren, ~ str_remove_all(.x, "[()]"))

  status_pat <- regex(
    "\\b(retired|shutdown|shut down|closed|decommissioned|merged|indef shutdown|non-operational|dismantled)\\b",
    ignore_case = TRUE
  )

  alt_name <- map_chr(
    paren_clean,
    ~ paste(.x[!str_detect(.x, status_pat)], collapse = " | ")
  )

  status_from_paren <- map_chr(
    paren_clean,
    ~ paste(.x[str_detect(.x, status_pat)], collapse = " | ")
  )

  status_from_main <- str_extract(
    x,
    regex(
      "[- ]+(retired|shutdown|shut down|closed|decommissioned|merged|indef shutdown|non-operational|dismantled).*$",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    )
  )

  plant_base <- x %>%
    str_remove_all("\\([^)]*\\)") %>%
    str_remove(
      regex(
        "[- ]+(retired|shutdown|shut down|closed|decommissioned|merged|indef shutdown|non-operational|dismantled).*$",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    str_squish()

  plant_match <- plant_base %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_replace_all("&", " and ") %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    str_replace_all("[[:punct:]]", " ") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\b(llc|lp|inc|ltd|facility|plant|project|station|company|co|powerhouse|generating|aggregate|unit)\\b", " ") %>%
    str_squish()

  tibble(
    raw_name = x,
    plant_base = plant_base,
    alt_name = na_if(alt_name, ""),
    status_info = na_if(str_squish(paste(status_from_paren, status_from_main)), ""),
    plant_match = plant_match
  )
}

# replace these with your actual column names
nameplate_clean <- nameplate |>
    fill(c(`CEC Plant ID`, `Plant Name`, `Company Name`, County, State), .direction = "down") |>
    transmute(`Plant Name`, Year, `Capacity (MW)`) %>%
    bind_cols(clean_generator_name(.$`Plant Name`))

nqc_clean <- nqc |>
  group_by(`Generator Name`, year) |>
  slice_max(order_by = capacity, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(year = as.character(year)) |>
  transmute(`Generator Name`, year, capacity) %>%
  bind_cols(clean_generator_name(.$`Generator Name`))

# exact on cleaned name
exact1 <- nameplate_clean %>%
  inner_join(
    nqc_clean,
    by = join_by(Year == year, plant_match),
    suffix = c("_nameplate", "_nqc")
  ) %>%
  filter(`Capacity (MW)` >= capacity) %>%
  mutate(score = 0, match_type = "exact_clean")

# exact on alternate name from list1
exact2 <- nameplate_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(
    alt_match = alt_name %>%
      str_to_lower() %>%
      str_replace_all("[[:punct:]]", " ") %>%
      str_squish()
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    nqc_clean,
    by = join_by(Year == year),
    suffix = c("_nameplate", "_nqc")
  ) %>%
  filter(alt_match == plant_match_nqc, `Capacity (MW)` >= capacity) %>%
  mutate(score = 0.001, match_type = "exact_alt")

matched_ids <- bind_rows(exact1, exact2) %>%
  distinct(`Plant Name`, Year)

leftover <- nameplate_clean %>%
  anti_join(matched_ids, by = c("Plant Name", "Year"))

fuzzy <- leftover %>%
  inner_join(
    nqc_clean,
    by = join_by(Year == year),
    suffix = c("_nameplate", "_nqc"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(`Capacity (MW)` >= capacity) %>%
  mutate(
    dist_main = stringdist(plant_match_nameplate, plant_match_nqc, method = "jw"),
    dist_alt = if_else(
      !is.na(alt_name_nameplate),
      stringdist(
        alt_name_nameplate %>%
          str_to_lower() %>%
          str_replace_all("[[:punct:]]", " ") %>%
          str_squish(),
        plant_match_nqc,
        method = "jw"
      ),
      NA_real_
    ),
    name_dist = pmin(dist_main, dist_alt, na.rm = TRUE),
    cap_ratio = capacity / `Capacity (MW)`,
    score = name_dist + 0.05 * (1 - cap_ratio)
  ) %>%
  filter(name_dist <= 0.18) %>%
  group_by(`Plant Name`, Year, `Capacity (MW)`) %>%
  slice_min(score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(match_type = "fuzzy")

final_matches <- bind_rows(exact1, exact2, fuzzy)



check_matches <- final_matches |>
    select(raw_name_nameplate, raw_name_nqc, match_type)

    # writexl::write_xlsx("nameplate_nqc.xlsx")

nqc_clean |>
    filter(str_detect(str_to_lower(`Generator Name`), "amy"))
```


```{r}
nameplate_nqc <- bind_rows(exact1, exact2) |>
    select(raw_name_nameplate, `Capacity (MW)`, raw_name_nqc, capacity, Year) |>
    rename(generator_nameplate = raw_name_nameplate,
           nameplate_capacity = `Capacity (MW)`,
           generator_nqc = raw_name_nqc,
           nqc = capacity,
           year = Year) |>
    left_join(nameplate_clean, by = join_by(generator_nameplate == `Plant Name`,
                                            year == Year,
                                            nameplate_capacity == `Capacity (MW)`)) |>
    writexl::write_xlsx("nameplate_nqc_exact.xlsx")
```
